abstract: Evaluates universal step-free circulation paths, hearing loops, and sensory spaces
system_message:
You are the Accessibility and inclusion auditor (ACC), responsible for evaluating universal step-free circulation paths, hearing loops, and sensory spaces across potential summit venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Sensory respite spaces（SENS）
information_points.content:
ACC-SENS-CJK：Based on the universal design floor plan audit, Praterstern Expo Congress Center provides a sensory quiet room volume of 80 m3 dedicated to sensory relaxation areas in acoustically isolated quiet rooms within the venue perimeter.
ACC-SENS-45S：A universal design floor plan audit reveals that Danube Waterfront Exhibition Palace features a total sensory quiet room volume of 140 m3 enclosed for sensory relaxation areas within acoustically isolated quiet rooms.
ACC-SENS-PFT：The universal design floor plan audit records that Belvedere Grand International Forum has a sensory quiet room volume of 200 m3 enclosed within acoustically isolated sensory relaxation spaces.

information_points.title: Evaluates universal step-free circulation paths, hearing loops, and sensory spaces（INCL）
information_points.content:
ACC-INCL-V04：A universal accessibility statutory survey confirms that Danube Waterfront Exhibition Palace satisfies step-free stage and seating accessibility with true compliance, featuring full step-free accessibility across auditorium ingress routes, podium, and main presenter stage via permanent ramps or dedicated elevators.
ACC-INCL-CPU：The universal accessibility statutory survey indicates that step-free stage and seating accessibility is false for Belvedere Grand International Forum, failing to provide full step-free accessibility across auditorium ingress routes, podium, and main presenter stage via permanent ramps or dedicated elevators.
ACC-INCL-RTT：According to the universal accessibility statutory survey, the auditorium ingress routes, podium, and main presenter stage at Praterstern Expo Congress Center achieve full step-free accessibility compliance via permanent ramps or dedicated elevators, confirming that step-free stage and seating accessibility is true.
